sentences.text: Ms. Manisha Rana Singh, Aga for the State.

Mr. S.K. Jain, Senior Advocate assisted by Mr. Rajeev Sami,
 Advocate for the informant.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)

The applicant seeks anticipatory bail in FIR No.419 of 2024 dated 07.05.2024, under Sections 420,
506, 467, 468, 471 IPC, Police Station Kotwali Jwalapur, District Haridwar.
2.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

3. According to the FIR, the co-accused Rajkumar Sharma, executed an agreement to sale with Smt.
Padmawati to purchase certain property.
Since, the co- accused Rajkumar Sharma was a Japanese national, sale-deed was not executed and cheques were returned.
But, the co-accused Rajkumar Sharma requested the informant to constitute a company along with Vivek Sharma.
He was nephew of the co-accused Raj Kumar Sharma.
The company was formed, but Vivek Sharma started operating the bank account on his own.
The FIR is quite in detail.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the agreement to sale with Padmawati is not executed; the co-accused Raj Kumar Sharma had filed a suit for specific performance.

Thereafter,
Padmawati executed a sale-deed in favour of the applicant, who was the power of attorney holder of Rajkumar Sharma in the year 2015.
Thereafter, in the year 2018, Padmawati had filed a suit for cancellation of the sale-deed, which is still pending.
He would submit that no offence is made out.

5. Learned Senior Counsel appearing for the informant would submit that, in fact, both the power of attorneys were fake; the suit for specific performance was never decreed; even the power of attorney did not provide for sale/purchase of a property.
6.
State as well as informant to file objections.

sentences.text:
8. Having considered, as an ad-interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail subject to his furnishing personal bond and two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer ("AO"), subject to the following:-
(i) The applicant shall not approach in any manner, whatsoever, any of the witnesses in the case.
(ii) He shall cooperate with the investigation.
(iii) He shall not leave the country without prior permission of the concerned court.
(iv) He shall deposit his passport with the AO.
The passport may only be returned by the order of the court concerned.
If the applicant does not have passport, he shall give an undertaking to that effect to the AO.
(v) The applicant shall also give an undertaking on (i), (ii) & (iii) above.
(Ravindra Maithani, J.) 15.07.2024
